question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Pass the buck
solution:
The correct answer is: **Blaming another person.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**pass the buck**" means to shift
